desktop.aNativeServiceOwnsThisConnection: A native service owns this connection. Start or inspect its original registration through service management; DeliDev will not launch a competing server.
desktop.theServerWasExplicitlyStoppedSta: The server was explicitly stopped. Start it only when you intend to resume its local lifecycle.
desktop.aLocalConnectionAttemptIsAlready: A local connection attempt is already running. Wait for it to finish.
desktop.theBundledDelidevExecutableIsMis: The bundled DeliDev executable is missing. Repair the desktop installation.
desktop.theLocalServerCouldNotConnect_88: The local server could not connect. Inspect DeliDev server status and its private log, then retry.
desktop.localStartupHasNotCompletedCheck: Local startup has not completed. Check server status before retrying; accepted work may continue.
desktop.theRunningServerUsesADifferent_3: The running server uses a different version or listener. Preserve its sessions and use a compatible client or explicitly stop it before changing the server.
desktop.thisDesktopCredentialIsUnavailab: This desktop credential is unavailable or revoked. Use Check desktop registration to inspect it and explicitly recover a revoked local registration.
desktop.theRetainedLocalConnectionRequir: The retained local connection requires inspection. Preserve its original pairing and server data.
desktop.thePrivateDelidevConfigurationDi: The private DeliDev configuration directory is unavailable. Check this computer's user configuration.
desktop.delidevIsDisconnectedOnThisCompu: DeliDev is disconnected on this computer. Open Troubleshooting to start it when you are ready.
desktop.delidevCouldNotFinishStartingRet: DeliDev could not finish starting. Retry or open Troubleshooting for help.
desktop.openTheDelidevDesktopAppTo_5990b: Open the DeliDev desktop app to connect. Browser clients are not supported.
desktop.delidevCouldNotVerifyThisConnect: DeliDev could not verify this connection. Retry or open Troubleshooting for help.
desktop.keychainFailed: Keychain access could not be confirmed
desktop.keychainPrompt: If macOS asks for permission, allow access.
desktop.keychainConfirmation: Keychain access was canceled or denied. Allow access when macOS asks, then try again.
desktop.keychainUnavailable: Keychain access is unavailable. Check this computer’s Keychain and try again.
desktop.keychainRecovery: A saved credential needs recovery. Preserve the original keys and restore access to the original macOS Keychain item, then retry this attempt. Continue without access to use workflows that do not need these credentials.
desktop.keychainExecutableChanged: The running server code could not be verified. Preserve the existing keys. Quit and reopen the trusted installed DeliDev app before retrying; do not approve an unexpected executable in the Keychain prompt.
desktop.keychainDenied: This desktop is no longer authorized. Preserve the existing keys. Open the connection controls here to inspect the original registration before explicitly re-registering.
desktop.keychainObservationFailed: The original access check could not be observed. Try again to observe the same attempt.
desktop.keychainSkipped: Keychain access checking was skipped for this launch. Saved account status is unchanged.
